The French already have nukes that are poised to attack the United States. Though their main targets are Poland and Germany. (Seriously.)

Also: If you apply this reasoning consistently then the Chinese build up is already a non-theoretical thing that's happening. And was before Trump. Turning nuclear binary game theory into trinary is WAY more of a threat. Why is that not your bigger concern?

Given that my information is correct unless the French military is lying I'm going to give it a roughly 99% chance of being correct. French nuclear strategy is public.

French military doctrine explicitly includes rapid fire capabilities to hit the United States and has since the Cold War. It also has a doctrine of nuking allies territory if they are losing a war and feel nukes will slow down the advancing army (mostly in Germany and now Poland). It also has the "warning shot" doctrine (ultime avertissement) where French doctrine allows the use of a single nuclear weapon lower on the escalation ladder than anyone else.

That said, I agree the chances of France doing it to the US are low. On the other hand, China has been going through a massive re-armament such that we are approaching a world with three major nuclear powers. And I do think that is destabilizing.
